notes:
CRM notes (shorthand, from AE/SE):
- Company: mid-market CX platform, 450 employees, heavy chat + search use.
- Primary ask: move quickly from hosted api to dedicated for predictability once perf locked. want a clear cost model.
- Workload: chat agents for customer support (p95 latency target ~ <200ms), batch embedding jobs for nightly search index, reranking for CSAT follow-ups.
- Throughput target: steady-state 60-100 reqs/s for chat at peak; embeddings batch ~25k docs/night.
- Cost sensitivity: high — procurement pushed for < $X per 1M tokens (internal goal: reduce token unit cost by 40% vs current managed provider).
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models (13B quantized variants), fallback to 7B for spikes. Interested in quantization profiles (INT8 for cheap inference, FP16 for quality-sensitive flows).
- Routing: want policy-based routing (latency-first for live chat, cost-first for background jobs). request ability to pin versions and automatic fallback.
- Security: must have SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for EMEA customers. VPC required for dedicated deployment.
- Recent asks: sample cost model spreadsheets, sample quantization/latency benchmarks for 13B int8, example batching configs (max_batch_size vs latency tradeoffs).
- Quote from CTO: 'If the math doesn't show 30-40% unit cost reduction, stick with hosted for now.'
- Workshop objective: deliver recommended batching + caching settings, expected unit costs for chat and embeddings, recommended model profile (13B int8 vs 7B fp16) and rollout plan.
- Notes: SE to run micro-benchmarks on Dedicated staging (seq len 512 typical, MLP heavy queries), provide token-per-request distribution and cost estimation table.
- Action items: Jordan to deliver micro-bench results by 2025-02-12; Riley to push legal on DPA; Maya to prepare onboarding plan if POC converts.
- Stages: evaluation -> procurement once budget sign-off.
- Internal risk: procurement timeline May-June may slip ARR.
